role: County research universe and assessment display boundaries; not a hydrant source
distribution: Official uscensusbureau/citysdk repository hosted on GitHub

coordinate_system.datum_status: GeoJSON longitude/latitude convention used for display; explicit source datum not supplied in saved GeoJSON and not independently verified. Do not use these simplified boundaries for precise property containment.

geographic_scope: 2022 U.S. counties and county equivalents, filtered by STATEFP == 48; all 254 Texas county codes present
update_information: 2022 file vintage. Repository README states archived and no longer maintained. No assertion of 2026 boundary currency.
reuse_terms: Repository MIT license saved as evidence/reference/census-citysdk-license.txt. License explicitly covers software and associated documentation; no separate dataset-specific terms in saved GeoJSON. Retain notice and verify any downstream data-specific requirements.

cross_check.classification: third-party mirror/sample dataset, not primary-source verification
cross_check.result: All 254 Texas county names and FIPS pairs agree exactly with Census CitySDK file. Not evidence of independent data lineage.
cross_check.origin_uncertainty: Exact upstream dataset/vintage not documented in saved Plotly README. Census-style attributes alone do not prove provenance.
cross_check.reuse_terms: MIT repository license saved; upstream dataset-specific terms not independently verified.

limitations: 1:20,000,000 generalized boundaries are for a statewide display only, not survey, precise county assignment, service-area inference, or distance calculation.
County identity validation does not assess any hydrant sources or county research completion.
An empty or uncolored county means research/coverage status only; never means hydrants do not exist.
No area-based hydrant-coverage denominator may be derived from these boundaries without separately evidenced inventory coverage polygons.
next_action: When authoritative Census web endpoints are accessible, cross-check county identities and download the current applicable boundary release; retain this version as the run reference.
